583 apographo {ap-og-raf'-o}

源於 575 和 1125; 動詞

欽定本 - tax 3, write 1; 4

1) 登記
 1a) 登記在納稅名冊
 1b) (喻意) 登記於神的記錄 (#來12:23|)
record.edic_text:
583 apographo {ap-og-raf'-o}

from 575 and 1125;; v

AV - tax 3, write 1; 4

1) to write off, copy (from some pattern)
2) to enter in a register or records
   2a) spec. to enter in public records the names of men, their
       property and income
   2b) to enrol
